name: Clipboard
description: Copies a value with clear confirmation: a copy button, an icon button with a confirmation tooltip, or a copy field showing the value beside its button. The label changes to Copied for the timeout and the result is announced in a live region; a failure is announced too. Every stack uses the behavior package's copy helper, with a fallback where the async Clipboard API is missing.

livewire.name: clipboard
capabilities: New in Livewire. Runs on the shared apuiClipboard Alpine component; a changed value from Livewire copies the new one
copy and error are DOM events on the root (x-on:copy, x-on:error)

react.name: Clipboard
capabilities: onCopy gets the value; onError the failure

vue.name: Clipboard
capabilities: copy gets the value; error the failure

props.name: value
props.description: What to copy. The field variant shows it.

props.name: timeout
props.description: How long Copied (or the failure) shows, in ms.

props.name: variant
props.description: An outline button with the icon and label; a ghost icon button whose confirmation shows as a tooltip below it; or the value in a read-only box joined to an outline button (the spec's copy field), for links, keys and IDs. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: size
props.description: The button's size, and the field's height. Use md for a field in a form. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's label; the icon button's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Copy' ).
props.a11y: Name the button after what it copies when a page has several, such as "Copy share link".

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: The label after a copy. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Copied' ).

props.name: copiedMessage
props.description: Announced after a copy, and shown in the icon button's tooltip. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Copied to clipboard' ).

props.name: errorMessage
props.default: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
props.description: Announced (and shown in the icon button's tooltip) when the copy fails. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __().

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { button: '…', field: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The wrapper, with data-variant, data-size and data-state (idle, copied, failed): a span, or a div for the field.

parts.name: button
parts.description: A neutral Button (outline, or ghost and icon-only for the icon variant) with the copy icon and label; a check and copiedLabel, in the success color, while copied.

parts.name: field
parts.description: The field variant's read-only box, in the mono font on the sunken surface.

parts.name: value
parts.description: The value in the field, LTR in every direction, cut with an ellipsis when long.

parts.name: tooltip
parts.description: The role=status live region with copiedMessage or errorMessage. Hidden but announced; shown as a tooltip below the icon button.

events.name: error
events.description: The copy failed, in both the Clipboard API and the fallback.

requirements: The result is announced in a role=status live region, success or failure; never a silent copy.
The label changes to Copied while copied; the icon button's accessible name does too.
The value in a copy field reads LTR in every direction and stays selectable, so it can be copied by hand when copying fails.
